title: make 0.17 work on macos and slim down the macos nix devshell
body:
A few notes:

- So we need to build `afl` with `LLVM` 22. I got `Unknown attribute kind (91) (Producer: 'zig 0.17.0' Reader: 'LLVM 17.0.6')` when trying to run afl, which is `ATTR_KIND_DEAD_ON_UNWIND`.
- I slimmed down the macos devshell closure. ~4.5 GiB down to 3.5 GiB


**AI disclaimer:**
[1f75c29](https://github.com/ghostty-org/ghostty/pull/14537/commits/1f75c29856f95df2f104f70b421515b2f13d43f4) was purely slopped up by AI, I did a pass over it and it didn't seem harmfull/stupid and it fixed a build failure. 

The rest are based upon existing commits in the original branch I target + https://ziglang.org/download/0.17.0/release-notes.html

[9f97316](https://github.com/ghostty-org/ghostty/pull/14537/commits/9f973164de09588cc9b1bf0b2806223fb441ab01) contains a diff impl than what the zig changelog contains re bitCast and type punning

@@ -28,6 +28,17 @@ set -eu
 in="$1"
 out="$2"
 
+# Zig 0.17 passes generated paths relative to the build root. Preserve
+# their meaning when we change into the temporary directory below.
+case "$in" in
+/*) ;;
+*) in="$PWD/$in" ;;
+esac
+case "$out" in
+/*) ;;
+*) out="$PWD/$out" ;;
+esac
+
 tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
 trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
